title: Baire closed-cover interior theorem
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $Y\subseteq X$ a nonempty subspace with the induced topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Assume $Y$ is locally compact and Hausdorff. Let $I$ be a countable set and let $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ be closed subsets of $Y$ with $Y=\bigcup_{i\in I} A_i$. Then some $A_i$ has nonempty interior in $Y$.
